research.claim: BI Publisher (Oracle Analytics Publisher) data models define the data source and produce XML; RTF templates built with the Template Builder Word add-in define layout; reports tie a data model to a template
BI Publisher report output can be exported as RTF, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and other formats
